_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft compiled 2026-09-26. NDLEA allegations and court-ordered wanted notices are not convictions. Four associates remain listed on NDLEA’s live wanted-person page as reviewed 2026-09-26; this does not establish present location. Suleiman’s criminal-charge status is last explicitly verified in NDLEA’s 2025-02-10 release. A separately reported July 2026 civil asset forfeiture is not a criminal verdict. NDLEA sources vary the order and spelling of Olanrewaju’s name and spell Alate’s surname Bakare/Zakare; canonical names follow the live wanted roster. A 2024 NDLEA release also uses Murphy for Oluwafemi while its 2025 notice uses Murphy for Ilori; the 2025 alias is assigned only to Ilori here, with no inferred identity link. Country markers reflect person-specific alleged historical operating activity in Nigeria, not nationality, residence, arrest venue alone, or destination countries. Ilori and Alate have blank regions because the reviewed sources do not place their individual operations in a country. No precise addresses, routes, live whereabouts, enforcement gaps, or photos without file-level reuse rights.
